faq.question: What are your hours?

faq.question: What is your cancellation policy?

faq.answer: There is a 15 minute grace period. After that we may need to shorten or reschedule so we stay on time for the next guest.

booking.new_vs_returning: Same link for everyone. New clients are guided to pick a consultation first if they are unsure what to book.
booking.what_client_sees: A list of services and stylists with open time slots. Client picks a service, a stylist, and a time, then enters their info and a card to hold the spot.

pricing.notes: Price depends on length and density. Toner included.
Renata only. Always starts with a consultation.
Hair plus install. Consultation required first.

policies.deposit: A card on file is required to book. A 50% deposit is taken for color corrections and extension installs.
policies.no_show: No-shows are charged the full price of the booked service.
policies.cancellation: 24 hour notice required to cancel or reschedule. Cancellations under 24 hours are charged 50% of the booked service.
policies.late_arrival: 15 minute grace period. After 15 minutes the appointment may be shortened or rescheduled at the stylist's discretion.
policies.first_time_client: New color and extension clients are encouraged to book a free consultation first so we can match the goal to the right service and give an accurate quote.

salon_basics.parking: Free street parking on Pearl after 6pm and all day Sunday. Paid lot on the corner of 18th and Pearl, about a 2 minute walk. Metered spots out front during the day.

service_menu.color: Lumen does full and partial balayage, foilayage, full highlights, root touch-ups, all-over color, glosses, and color correction. Blonding and lived-in color are the studio's signature. Color correction from previous work elsewhere is handled by Renata and always starts with a consultation.
service_menu.other: Free 15 to 20 minute consultations for color, color correction, and extensions, bookable through the same link.
service_menu.extensions: Hand-tied extensions for length and fullness. Mia and Renata handle extensions. New extension clients book a consultation first to match color and assess fit, since pricing depends heavily on the amount of hair and the install.
service_menu.treatments: K18 bond repair, gloss and toner refreshes, and deep conditioning add-ons. These are usually added onto a color appointment rather than booked alone.
service_menu.cuts_and_styling: Womens cuts, dry cuts, blowouts, and special-occasion styling. Cuts are available with all three stylists. Blowouts are a popular add-on after color.

off_limits_topics: No salon-specific off-limits topics beyond the standard bot guardrails.
voice_and_tone_notes: Renata calls regulars 'love' and is warm but not over the top. Keep it friendly and grounded, not bubbly or salesy.
